div.font:
Criterios de seleccion:
EFA: KMO ≥ 0.50, Bartlett p<0.05, carga ≥ 0.40, rotacion oblimin
IRT: discrimination a ≥ 0.50 (2PL dichotomous, GRM polytomous)
LCA: BIC minibum + entropy ≥ 0.80 + minimum class ≥ 5% sample
Performance anchor: average 30 Plausible Values ​​(Mat + Lec + Cie) PISA 2022
